aliases: C'estbon Chinese Football Association Super League
name: Chinese Football Super League
notes: Top division of Chinese football, 23rd CSL season, running 6 March to 8 November 2026 with 16 clubs.

Title sponsor C'estbon (CR Beverage); strategic partners Nike and Migu; partners Lenovo and Tsingtao; game partner Tencent FC Online; media partners CCTV Sports and Migu, per the league's official competitions page.
Club-level shirt sponsors and club ownership chains not yet sourced from primary documents.
